rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Reference implementation demonstrating production-ready MCP server patterns including multi-tenant isolation, OAuth 2.1, rate limiting, circuit breakers, and observability via Prometheus, Jaeger, and Grafana. Includes a four-agent support system (Planner/Retriever/Synthesizer/Critic) backed by PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Qdrant, and Redis. Supports both stdio and HTTP transports.
